messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Org shift operational plan + Q4 OKR handoffs (confidential)

Team —

Quick note: leadership and PeopleOps are asking for a concise operational plan for the small org shift we discussed yesterday (reallocating two ICs between Product Infra and Serving Runtime) and a matching OKR rollforward so stakeholders can sign off before the upcoming board review. This is confidential for now — please do not forward outside the recipients list.

I need the following by EOD Monday:
- One-paragraph rationale for each reassignment (manager-level)
- Updated Q4 OKR targets impacted by headcount changes (top-level numbers only)
- Any known risks to latency or release commitments

I've attached a draft OKR spreadsheet and a short briefing PDF. Use the Drive link below to drop edits. If you'd prefer to talk, I can carve 30 minutes Friday morning for a quick calibration.

Attachments:
- Q4_OKR_Rollforward_draft_v2.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
- role-transition-briefing.pdf (application/pdf)

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b-example-OKR-rollforward

Thanks — please keep this tight and factual.

Kimberly Park
Director, Engineering (Serving Runtime)
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Org shift operational plan + Q4 OKR handoffs (confidential)

Kimberly —

Thanks for the clear ask. Quick notes from my side after chatting with the two managers this morning:
- Rationale: shifting one senior infra engineer to Serving Runtime for kernel-integration work (6 weeks ramp, then 1 FTE equivalent) and moving a mid-level infra engineer back to Product Infra to support multi-tenant autoscaler tuning. Both moves reduce cross-team context-switches we saw in prior rollouts.
- OKR impact: estimate ~4% temporary hit to our 99th percentile latency metric for one sprint; I think we can largely recover via targeted batching config. Recommend we keep the latency SLO target stable but flag potential remediation work in the backlog.
- Risks: onboarding time, small documentation gap for KV cache ops; both are mitigatable if we prioritize a 1-week pairing plan.

I'll add a short manager rationale paragraph into the spreadsheet by EOD. If Laura can take the ownership section on stakeholder comms, we can present a single slide to execs.

Vivek
VP, Production Engineering
Redwood Inference

Kimberly / Vivek —

I've populated the stakeholder comms tab and added a slide outline for the exec summary. Key edits I made:
- Consolidated OKR numbers to show net-impact instead of per-person deltas (execs prefer top-line).
- Added a mitigation runbook: two-week pairing, prioritized docs, and a rollback trigger (if latency delta > 6% after 2 sprints).
- Noted headcount shadowing for the senior infra engineer during the first sprint.

Marcus: please confirm the timeline on your end for releasing the autoscaler patch; if that's slipping we need to escalate.

Attachments added to Drive: updated Q4_OKR_Rollforward_draft_v2.xlsx (edited)

I also dropped a short confidential note to PeopleOps (private) asking for a curated offer packet timeline — tagging Neha to follow up with them once we finalize the plan.

Laura Bennett
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference
